title: P1: Federation spec — 10 ambiguities
description: 1. Inconsistent identity field naming across Peer/* methods. 2. Peer/groupUpdate no handling of unknown contacts. 3. Missing leave action for non-admin. 4. deliveryState received confusingly named. 5. No error codes/response shape for Peer/* failures. 6. No guidance for partial group delivery. 7. No Space-level federation methods. 8. replyTo/threadRootId resolution failure undefined. 9. No message ordering/conflict resolution defined. 10. Peer/receipt Receiver Behavior ambiguously describes whose preference.
